additional_boundaries.job_state: PipelineManager._dispatch_action scopes a mutable context shared by child tasks; policy denial prevents final COMPLETED and sets FAILED with the code; completed artifact promotion refuses denied jobs
additional_boundaries.fallback: inference entrypoints and shared CLI process runner check only job-local prior denial, never the global flag for non-OpenRouter calls
additional_boundaries.distributed_dispatch: create_audit_job and assignment_params reject frozen plans containing OpenRouter; worker subprocess environment explicitly preserves the flag

production_before.workers: one registered worker, offline, intake disabled, zero active jobs/processes; all attempts terminal

environment_scope: OS process environment. Editing an EnvironmentFile does not mutate running process environments. Restart only when idle. The same flag must be configured on any independently deployed worker/gateway before enabling their intake; no active remote worker is part of this deployment.
non_openrouter: direct Claude/Opus, Codex/Astra, Gemini direct, local preparation, V3 logic, catalog, Human Mapping and Bridge are not selected by the flag
excluded_network_operations: No balances, quota, canary, inference, authorization probes or other OpenRouter calls performed
